verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, but it ships client-facing software (GDHQ, Catalyze, the Contract Generator, the D&O Questionnaire Portal), so a telemetry opt-out question applies to those platforms. Nothing in the evidence mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics controls or opt-out mechanisms for any of these tools. The data-privacy practice and the secure Azure-hosted ChatGD are legal services and an internal tool, not user-facing tracking controls.
